bagPolicy.summary: The Novo says bags may not exceed 14 × 14 inches; its restricted-item list specifically calls out backpacks and large bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Accessible parking is directly below The Novo in the LA Live East Parking Garage; the venue links to its Getting Here page for other parking options.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Bars inside the venue sell snacks, food and alcohol. Food and beverage purchases are cashless; outside food and drink are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: All entrances are accessible. ADA viewing is on the main floor second tier house left and a balcony platform; request a sign-language interpreter at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once a ticket has been scanned, guests may not leave and re-enter.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens two hours before doors for each show; the FAQ does not state a separate will-call pickup procedure.
